facts.fact: When Gelicia Walpole joined StackAdapt in July 2021, there were 16 StackAdapters in the UK for her to support.
facts.quote: When I joined StackAdapt in July 2021, there were just 16 StackAdapters in the UK to support.

facts.fact: As of the article, StackAdapt's People and Culture manager for EMEA and APAC represented more than 140 colleagues across 9 countries.
facts.quote: Now, I represent more than 140 colleagues across 9 different countries!

facts.fact: StackAdapt's #Kudos Slack channel, where employees shout out colleagues, had hundreds of members according to the article.
facts.quote: The channel has hundreds of members already, and there are positive messages shared in it every day!

facts.fact: The blog post was published on 22 August 2022.
